Sandbox_KIPN_LORDEnabled: LORD: Enable Legend of the Red Dragon
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDEnabled_tooltip: Master switch for the Play LORD door game. When off, the menu entry is hidden and the commands are refused.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDEnabled_help: Master switch for the Play LORD door game. When off, the menu entry is hidden and the commands are refused.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDForestFightsPerDay_tool: How many forest encounters each adventurer gets per in-game day. Also restored by 'Rest Until Dawn'.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDForestFightsPerDay_help: How many forest encounters each adventurer gets per in-game day. Also restored by 'Rest Until Dawn'.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDExpMultiplier_tooltip: Scales all experience gained. 1.0 is a slow classic grind; the 1.5 default lets a casual player reach the Red Dragon in a handful of in-game days. Raise it for a faster server.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDExpMultiplier_help: Scales all experience gained. 1.0 is a slow classic grind; the 1.5 default lets a casual player reach the Red Dragon in a handful of in-game days. Raise it for a faster server.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDGoldMultiplier_tooltip: Scales all gold earned from the forest. Higher values let players buy the weapon and armour tiers faster.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDGoldMultiplier_help: Scales all gold earned from the forest. Higher values let players buy the weapon and armour tiers faster.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDDeathGoldPenalty_toolti: Percent of ON-HAND gold lost when you are killed. Banked gold, gems and gear are always safe. 0 makes death cost nothing but a day.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDDeathGoldPenalty_help: Percent of ON-HAND gold lost when you are killed. Banked gold, gems and gear are always safe. 0 makes death cost nothing but a day.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDRestCooldownMinutes: LORD: Rest Until Dawn Cooldown (real minutes)
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDRestCooldownMinutes_too: Real-time minutes a player must wait between 'Rest Until Dawn' uses. 0 (default) lets players start a new game-day whenever they run out of forest turns -- best for casual drop-in play.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDRestCooldownMinutes_hel: Real-time minutes a player must wait between 'Rest Until Dawn' uses. 0 (default) lets players start a new game-day whenever they run out of forest turns -- best for casual drop-in play.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDPvPEnabled_tooltip: Reserved for a future release. Has no effect yet.
Sandbox_KIPN_LORDPvPEnabled_help: Reserved for a future release. Has no effect yet.
